What to understand at MT2

Challenge
A tower test with additional restrictions or rules. Read them before choosing a blueprint: a normal farming setup may not satisfy them.
Laboratory experiment
An element-themed progression system with its own tasks and rewards. It provides another route to modules.
Software
Headquarters research that changes how tower testing progresses. Unlocking software and researching it are separate steps.

What you are working toward

  • Complete the MT3 objectives shown in Headquarters. The older reference lists 40 maximized modules and 7 regions.
  • Keep your economy growing while you collect modules from more than one system.

Milestone reference; the current game takes precedence. [S02]

A practical route through this stage

The order below is an suggested route based on community strategies. It is a suggested route, not the only valid build or a tested speedrun.

  1. Open up the buildings now available to you

    Inspect new Construction Firm options, including the Statue of Cubos and Shipyard as they become available. Learn what each produces before committing heavily. Continue to support the Workshop and Factory; new buildings should help progression rather than consume every resource at once. [S04]

  2. Try manageable challenges deliberately

    Read the challenge’s equipment restrictions, enemy rules and victory condition. Assemble a blueprint around those constraints. If a challenge remains far beyond your current strength, leave it and gain modules elsewhere instead of treating it as mandatory immediately. [S06]

  3. Work on Laboratory rewards

    Choose an experiment whose next task you understand and can complete with your current resources. Check the module reference for the reward and its conditions. Alternate Laboratory work with regional drops so you are not waiting on one rare source for every missing module. [S06] [S04]

  4. Keep Headquarters research supplied

    Improve available servers and use them for software you can currently research. Support the Power Plant where electricity is restricting progress. You are preparing an infrastructure advantage, not merely increasing tower damage. [S07]

  5. Finish your objectives and learn Critical Wavejump

    After reaching MT3, inspect and research Critical Wavejump when available. It uses your previous wave record to help revisit familiar territory. Establishing a highscore still requires a tower that can survive and kill at that point; a shortcut back to a record cannot fix a weak blueprint. [S02] [S07]

If you are stuck

My blueprint is full of attacks but performs poorly

Adding more effects is not always better than investing in a compatible core. Keep enough defense to survive and focus upgrades on attacks doing useful work.

A challenge rejects or defeats my normal build

Re-read its restrictions and reward conditions. Treat it as a separate puzzle rather than an ordinary region clear.

Ready to move on?

  • The MT3 counters in Headquarters are complete.
  • You know which available software still needs research.
After the promotion

MT3 leads to Facility AI. Keep improving the economy now so automation has useful production to operate once you unlock it. [S02] [S07]
